target_customer: Brazilian digital businesses, e-commerce and B2B platforms that process online payments through several providers
problem: Companies integrate one payment provider at a time and cannot easily switch, retry or route transactions between providers without engineering work.
business_model: B2B payments orchestration API (usage based fees, details not stated in sources)

founders.name: Alex Vilhena
founders.background_notes: YC bio says he was raised between Brazil and the US and spent seven years at tech companies across the US and Europe; employers and education not named.

founders.name: Thiago Garuti
previous_startups: Medicinae Solutions (health insurance receivables, sold to Afya)
founders.background_notes: YC bio: eight years at hedge funds in Rio, joined venture builder Finxi in 2015, founded Medicinae in 2016.

founders.name: Marcel Nicolay
founders.background_notes: Named as a partner of CEO Alex Vilhena and Thiago Garuti in the startups.com.br rebrand article; not listed on the YC page.

competitors.name: Juno (Locaweb)
competitors.what: Brazilian payment provider described as an orchestration player, later acquired by Locaweb

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating many payment providers and acquirers with routing, retries, tokenization and antifraud management is standard but demanding fintech engineering with compliance needs.

defensibility.rationale: Merchants integrated deeply into the orchestration layer face switching costs, but providers and global orchestrators can offer similar routing.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Brazilian providers advertise one API multi acquirer products; no acquisition of Malga was found and TOTVS corporate venture arm invested in 2025.

market_need_then: Brazilian merchants used many local payment methods and providers; the company reported processing R$15 billion in 2025 and R$4 billion planned for 2024, indicating demand, but no dated 2020 demand evidence was found.

branding.name_origin: The article that covers the rename was not fully readable; the origin of the name Malga was not found.
branding.domain_note: Uses malga.io; the earlier brand was Plug.

rebrands.why: Positioned as intelligent payments infrastructure after about a year and a half; one source suggests 2023, date not confirmed

brand_strength.rationale: Trade press covered the rebrand but no mascot, community or merch was found; the old name Plug was generic.

outcome_analysis: Malga, formerly Plug, grew from a 2020 Rio de Janeiro start into a payments orchestration company with 46 staff per YC, raised a small seed in 2021 and a 5.5 million dollar Series A in February 2025 led by TOTVS iDEXO and Costanoa. It reports R$15 billion processed in 2025 and plans to double it. It stays focused on Brazil, and there is no sign of an exit or distress.
notes: Company site malga.io fetch was rate limited, so site facts come from search snippets. Series A is stated by LatamList (5.5M) and Finsiders (R$32M); Caplight says March 2025, TOTVS profile February 25 2025. Bloomberg Linea 2021 seed amount comes from the headline seen in search only, investors not read. CB Insights total 8.38M and another source 10.3M are unverified. Competitor entries come from an aggregator without dates; no dated 2021 source was found. Rebrand date conflicts (about 2021/22 vs 2023).
